between Plum Street and Elm Street
overall width Central-Elm incl. warehouse/playground in the middle; each roadway printed 40'

notes: Scale bar: 50 ft = 171 px. McFarland Street is printed 30' between Central and Plum and 60' between Plum and Elm (same centreline, y~1367); it ends at Elm (T) - Benham Alley on sheet 15 is offset ~57 ft north and is not drawn here (compass rose covers the east side of Elm). W. Pearl is a 143' wide street between Central and Elm: west of Plum a railroad storage warehouse (C.C.C.&St.L., tracks in basement) stands in the middle with a 40' roadway labelled W. PEARL on each side; between Plum and Elm Public Play Grounds No. 1 fills the middle. I recorded the two open roadways: 'West Pearl Street' = north roadway (continues straight east of Elm as W. Pearl, 40'); 'West Pearl Street (south roadway)' ends at Elm. Both roadways end at Central (west side of Central is a continuous block line; Central crosses the railroad on a plank bridge there). Centre of the full 143' width is y~3187. Mulberry: 16' passage between W 3rd and W Pearl (north roadway) east of Plum, printed MULBERRY with CRUTE on a correction paste-over; ends at both streets. Duane (40', called Duane (Union) on sheet 13) and Burrows (28', sheet 13) T into the east side of Elm; their names are printed on sheet 13. Halpin Alley (printed HALPIN ALLEY, 10') runs Central to Plum, T at both ends. Circled figures in streets are grade elevations, not widths.
